title: 175. Find K Closest Elements

examples.explanation: The 4 closest elements to 3 are 1, 2, 3 and 4.
The 4 closest elements to -1 are 1, 2, 3 and 4.

hints: Use two pointers shrinking from both ends until k elements remain, discarding the farther end each time.
Equivalently, binary-search the left bound of the size-k window.
